context: M3 o6c. The fare who ran with Delroy's cash box, caught on W 41st St.

lines.speaker: npc.fare_runner
lines.text: Okay! Okay! It's all there! I got laid off Tuesday, man!

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: So did half the city. Give me the box. Go home.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Somebody on the corner saw that. A report with my shirt in it. Note to self: new shirt.
